title: 扶着墙站稳
description: 成人一手轻扶墙边固定栏杆，另一脚轻离地。

art_direction.medium: opaque gouache illustration with broad matte brush marks
art_direction.scene: A fictional adult stands beside a fixed low wall rail, one hand touching it lightly while one foot lifts only a few centimeters. The supporting knee remains soft and the pelvis level. Capture a calm face and free hand at the side, with trainers and a clear level floor visible. A bright open window and plain folded mat create an approachable exercise corner rather than an athletic performance scene. Use ink-and-wash illustration with sparse expressive contours, broad diluted color, and a pale blue, olive, and charcoal palette. Create one original 1536x1024 wordless scene, fictional fully clothed adults, natural anatomy; no brands, arrows or panels. Climbing stays low above continuous thick mats, with immediate step-down.
